title: Harley Quinn #0 Director's Cut DC New 52 August 2014 Amanda Conner Palmiotti
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Harley Quinn #0 Director's Cut (August 2014), DC Comics, The New 52 - $4.99 cover price. Written by Amanda Conner and Jimmy Palmiotti, cover by Amanda Conner. The Director's Cut edition of Harley's New 52 #0, with extra behind-the-scenes material. Rated T Teen.

Back cover: Falling Skies (TNT) ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
